_read_me: Allowlist of the default job sources, searched for every user. The complementary sources each user chooses are not listed here: they live in "extraSources" in that user's search.json, after the check-source script found them technically viable. "enabled": false turns a source off. Safe defaults: only change the limits if you have read the source's terms and accept the responsibility. Never add sites that need a login. See docs/sources.md.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.kind: public job pages without login (jobs-guest), as in ai-job-search
linkedin.duties: LinkedIn's User Agreement forbids automated access and its robots.txt disallows these pages: use it only for your own search, at low volume, at your own risk. Never log in, never share or republish the jobs. Set enabled to false to turn it off.

infojobs.name: InfoJobs
infojobs.kind: public search page without login (offers embedded as JSON in the page)
infojobs.apiDocs: https://developer.infojobs.net (official API, needs an app registered with an InfoJobs account; not used)
infojobs.termsReviewed: not readable on 2026-11-15: the legal page refuses automated access
infojobs.duties: robots.txt allows the search page and is followed. The terms could not be read and job boards usually forbid automated extraction: use it only for your own search, at low volume, at your own risk. Never log in, never share or republish the offers. Set enabled to false to turn it off.

indeed.name: Indeed
indeed.kind: public search page without login (job cards embedded as JSON; job pages are not opened)
indeed.apiDocs: none: Indeed has no public jobs API
indeed.duties: Personal, non-commercial job search only. robots.txt allows search pages and disallows job pages (/viewjob), so only the short extract on the search page is kept. Never log in, never apply automatically, never share or republish the offers. Set enabled to false to turn it off.
